newsitem.title: FRANCE: 11-nation military exercises set in Mediterranean.
newsitem.headline: 11-nation military exercises set in Mediterranean.

text.p: Naval war exercises involving more than 20,000 sailors and 62 warships from 11 nations begin on Sunday in the Mediterranean, French military officials said on Friday.
"Operation Golden Isles", an exercise which takes place every three years, will continue through June 2, the officials said.
Participating in addition to France will be Spain, Italy, Portugal, the United States, Germany, Belgium, Canada, Greece, Britain and Turkey.
Three aircraft carriers -- Paris' Clemenceau, Washington's Kennedy and Italy's Garibaldi -- are taking part in addition to six submarines.
